Department of Revenue Services State of Connecticut

TPG-189 (Rev. 12/21)

TPG-189 Request Change of Administrator in TSC or myconneCT Complete this form in blue or black ink only. Purpose: Use TPG-189 to appoint a new administrator of your current Department of Revenue Services (DRS), Taxpayer Service Center (TSC), or myconneCT account. Complete a separate TPG-189 for each TSC or myconneCT account that you need to change. Part 1 - Business Information In order to authenticate your identity, print all information exactly as shown on your Connecticut tax account.

Business name

Connecticut Tax Registration Number

Name of current TSC or myconneCT account administrator

Business telephone number

Address Number and street

PO Box City or town

State

ZIP Code

Part 2 - Verification Provide information as shown on a previously filed tax return (do not use information from the return you are attempting to file). The TSC or myconneCT account administrator will not be changed if the following information is not accurately completed. 1. Enter the tax type of the return previously filed.

1. Choose Return Filed

2. Enter the tax period of the return previously filed. (MM/DD/YYYY) 3. Enter the amount of tax liability of the return previously filed.

2.

3.

1.00

Check here if you would like to reset the TSC login.

Check here if you would like to reset myconneCT login. Part 3 - New Administrator

Name of NEW TSC or myconneCT account administrator

New administrator's telephone number

Part 4 - Confirmation Method Indicate how DRS should send your new temporary password. Select only one method below.

Mail to the same mailing address listed in Part 1 - Business Information.

Email to the following email address:

Fax to the following FAX number: How to Submit Request Submit your completed request using one of the following EMAIL to: ct.efile@ct.gov FAX to:

860-297-4761
